hypotheses.P0_exact_composition_matches_autograd: The all-attention local-operator recurrence has relative error at most 1e-5 against independent autograd checks.
hypotheses.P1_near8_gradient_fidelity: The near-eight attention program reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.90 at every source layer.
hypotheses.P2_near8_causal_direction: Its prospectively selected top-64 channels move the semantic score positively on at least 95 percent of pairs at every source layer.
hypotheses.P3_near8_retains_oracle_effect: Its mean finite top-64 shift is at least 80 percent of the endpoint-oracle top-64 shift at every source layer.
hypotheses.P4_near4_is_insufficient: Near-four fails either 0.90 gradient cosine or 0.90 finite-direction rate in at least one source layer.
hypotheses.P5_near_attention_beats_late_attention: Near-eight exceeds late-eight median gradient cosine by at least 0.10 at every source layer.
hypotheses.P6_mlp_only_is_insufficient: MLP-only gradient cosine is below 0.85 in every source layer.
hypotheses.P7_near8_recovers_oracle_support: Near-eight top-64 support Jaccard is at least 0.25 at every source layer.
